svg.title: Greenleaf owns the map, not just the most shops
svg.desc: Voronoi catchment map of thirty city pharmacies. Each cell is the neighbourhood for which one pharmacy is the closest to walk to, and its colour marks the chain that owns the shop: Greenleaf, Meridian Health, Cedar and Co, Aster Drugstore, and independent chemists. Greenleaf's stores sit on the roomy outskirts, so its cells cover about 35 percent of the city's area, the largest share of any chain, even though Meridian has almost as many shops packed into the dense centre. Seed dots mark each pharmacy; a few flagship stores are labelled. Hover or focus any cell to lift its whole chain's territory and dim the rest.
